@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8780'
+title: 'Mail step 7: an XCUITest of the demo app that checks the scroll anchors get the visibility report on a real screen'
+---
+Found in ^809cwz0. The hosted tests cannot prove that SwiftUI calls the onScrollTargetVisibilityChange action of ConversationView and that the action gives the report to ScrollAnchorManager. The action is an inline closure in the view body, so a test cannot get it. SwiftUI sends the report on a later update, and for the off-screen harness window it can send no report. ScrollAnchorManagerTests covers what the manager does with a report, and SessionTranscriptViewHostedTests covers the scroll target id of each row. No test covers the link between them.
+
+The demo app XCUITests (Examples/AgentViewKitDemo/Tests: ACPTabEndToEndTests, GalleryTabEndToEndTests) do not check this now.
+
+- [ ] Add an XCUITest in Examples/AgentViewKitDemo/Tests that, on a real screen, sends enough replies to fill the thread, scrolls up, and expects the scroll-to-bottom pill (the manager is unpinned only after a visibility report).
+- [ ] Expect that a tap on the pill brings the last row into view.
+
+Write all text in STE. #mail-step-7
\ No newline at end of file
